title: GTA 6 Price In India
yt_title: GTA 6 Price In India: Standard vs Ultimate 💰 #shorts
description:
GTA 6 costs Rs 5,999 for the Standard Edition and Rs 7,499 for the Ultimate Edition in India. It launches November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

#GTA6 #GTA6Price #GTA6India #GTAVI

lines.text: Here's exactly what GTA 6 costs in India.
The Standard Edition is five thousand nine hundred ninety nine rupees.
The Ultimate Edition goes up to seven thousand four hundred ninety nine.
That's a fifteen hundred rupee gap between the two.
It's on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S only, PC has no date yet.
And it unlocks tonight at midnight.
Standard or Ultimate, which one did you buy?
